categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies P2P message handling logic in `src/net_processing.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Breaks up the monolithic `PeerManagerImpl::ProcessMessage()` function by extracting nine message handlers into dedicated member functions. Reviewers note this encapsulation improves navigation and diff readability in `net_processing.cpp`, but it is an internal refactor that does not retire a known protocol hazard or alter network behavior.
